verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents an API endpoint for creating adjustment journal entries (account_uuid plus debit/credit amounts after querying Get Accounts), and states that a granted accountant can update journal entries and the chart of accounts, so an agent can post entries that an accountant later reviews and corrects. Nothing in the evidence shows a draft or pending status, so entries appear to post directly to the ledger with no queue holding them for approval. Missing for 10: a draft/unposted journal entry state, a review or approval queue for accountants, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven journal posting.
